name: Sundrel Works 80 EGEO
description: Key Features Cryptoendolith-Shield Stone Construction: Engineered with advanced stone material designed to provide superior protection and environmental stability for sensitive contents. Generous Internal Volume: Offers a spacious 1324-litre capacity, accommodating up to 41 shelves for organized storage of various items. Precise Climate Control: Maintains a constant internal temperature of 4°C and a stable humidity setpoint at 19% relative humidity, ideal for preserving delicate or perishable goods. Low-Oxygen Atmosphere: Features a controlled, low-oxygen environment to help inhibit oxidation and microbial growth, extending the shelf life of stored items. Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for customized solutions based on individual storage needs. Main Benefits Optimal Preservation: The combination of low temperature, regulated humidity, and reduced oxygen levels protects sensitive materials from spoilage, degradation, or contamination. High Capacity and Organization: With 41 adjustable shelves, users can efficiently store and categorize a wide range of items, from biological specimens to valuable artifacts. Durability and Security: The robust stone casing offers long-term durability and shields contents from external environmental fluctuations, physical damage, and unauthorized access. Customizable for Specific Needs: Adjustable climate settings and shelving configurations make this storage solution adaptable to diverse requirements, such as laboratory, archival, or industrial use. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Scientific and Laboratory Storage: Ideal for safely storing biological samples, reagents, or research materials that require precise environmental conditions. Museum and Archival Preservation: Perfect for maintaining the integrity of rare artifacts, manuscripts, or collectibles sensitive to humidity and oxygen exposure. Specialty Food and Beverage Storage: Suitable for preserving items like fine wines, cheeses, or specialty foods that benefit from controlled temperature and humidity. Industrial and Pharmaceutical Applications: Supports the secure storage of chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or other materials prone to degradation in standard environments. Frequently Asked Questions Is the case easy to use and maintain? Yes, the climate control system is user-friendly and designed for reliable, low-maintenance operation. What types of items are compatible? The case is suitable for any products or materials requiring low temperature, controlled humidity, and low-oxygen storage. How durable is the stone casing? The cryptoendolith-shield stone provides exceptional strength and environmental resistance, ensuring long-term protection for valuable contents. Can shelf configurations be adjusted? Yes, all 41 shelves are adjustable to accommodate items of various sizes and storage layouts. description_html:
Key Features

  • Cryptoendolith-Shield Stone Construction: Engineered with advanced stone material designed to provide superior protection and environmental stability for sensitive contents.
  • Generous Internal Volume: Offers a spacious 1324-litre capacity, accommodating up to 41 shelves for organized storage of various items.
  • Precise Climate Control: Maintains a constant internal temperature of 4°C and a stable humidity setpoint at 19% relative humidity, ideal for preserving delicate or perishable goods.
  • Low-Oxygen Atmosphere: Features a controlled, low-oxygen environment to help inhibit oxidation and microbial growth, extending the shelf life of stored items.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for customized solutions based on individual storage needs.

Main Benefits

  • Optimal Preservation: The combination of low temperature, regulated humidity, and reduced oxygen levels protects sensitive materials from spoilage, degradation, or contamination.
  • High Capacity and Organization: With 41 adjustable shelves, users can efficiently store and categorize a wide range of items, from biological specimens to valuable artifacts.
  • Durability and Security: The robust stone casing offers long-term durability and shields contents from external environmental fluctuations, physical damage, and unauthorized access.
  • Customizable for Specific Needs: Adjustable climate settings and shelving configurations make this storage solution adaptable to diverse requirements, such as laboratory, archival, or industrial use.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Scientific and Laboratory Storage: Ideal for safely storing biological samples, reagents, or research materials that require precise environmental conditions.
  • Museum and Archival Preservation: Perfect for maintaining the integrity of rare artifacts, manuscripts, or collectibles sensitive to humidity and oxygen exposure.
  • Specialty Food and Beverage Storage: Suitable for preserving items like fine wines, cheeses, or specialty foods that benefit from controlled temperature and humidity.
  • Industrial and Pharmaceutical Applications: Supports the secure storage of chemicals, pharmaceuticals, or other materials prone to degradation in standard environments.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the case easy to use and maintain? Yes, the climate control system is user-friendly and designed for reliable, low-maintenance operation.
  • What types of items are compatible? The case is suitable for any products or materials requiring low temperature, controlled humidity, and low-oxygen storage.
  • How durable is the stone casing? The cryptoendolith-shield stone provides exceptional strength and environmental resistance, ensuring long-term protection for valuable contents.
  • Can shelf configurations be adjusted? Yes, all 41 shelves are adjustable to accommodate items of various sizes and storage layouts.
